newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF wins Swiss, Polish radio deals.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF wins Swiss, Polish radio deals.

text.p: French defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF said on Tuesday it has won contracts from Switzerland and Poland to supply military VHF radios.

The Swiss GDA arms procurement office has awarded a contract to Ascom-Systec SA, a unit of Ascom and Thomson-CSF, to renew the park of PR4G tactical radios. The GDA programme budget for several thousand radios totals 490 million Swiss francs, a Thomson-CSF spokeswoman said. Thomson's Swiss partner will gain 60 percent of the contract content.
The Polish defence and industry ministries have also ordered the PR4G, with a programme budget of $50 million.
Thomson's Polish partner in the deal is Radmor SA. First deliveries to the Polish army will begin in 1997 and the whole contract covers several thousands of units.
Delivery to the Swiss forces will start in 1998 and run to 2002.
